body:
I am writing to suggest an enhancement to the ASVS item 12.2.1, which currently states: "Verify that files obtained from untrusted sources are validated to be of expected type based on the file's content."

While this item does emphasize the importance of validating file types, it does not explicitly mention the use of file magic numbers, extensions and MIME types for validation. File magic numbers are a sequence of bytes that uniquely identify the type of a file, file extensions are used to indicate the format of a file and MIME types are used to describe the content type of the file. All of these methods are crucial for ensuring the safety of uploaded files and should be included in the ASVS.

I propose the following update to item 12.2.1:

_Verify that files obtained from untrusted sources are validated to be of expected type based on the file's content, using methods such as checking file extensions, validating file magic numbers, and verifying MIME types._

title: Include Magic Numbers, MIME Type and File Extensions Validation in ASVS 12.2.1
